capabilities: Replace ${key} tokens in Live Preview and reading mode
Update all occurrences when a configured value changes
extras: README is mostly in Chinese with brief build and installation notes; no screenshots or advanced usage documented.
motivation: The author wanted variables as placeholders that display a configured value in both edit and reading mode, and that all change when the value is updated globally.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to define reusable variables whose value updates everywhere a placeholder appears.
summary: Placeholder substitution plugin that replaces ${key} tokens in notes with configured key-value pairs in Live Preview and reading mode.
